title: qontinui-studio import manifest
description: <inbox-dir>/manifest.yaml for `studio library import <inbox-dir>`. A list of entries, one per image file. The studio validates the WHOLE manifest before writing anything: one invalid entry refuses the import, and every problem is reported with its entry index. The YAML is read as plain data with YAML 1.2 scalars: only true/false are booleans (`yes`/`no` are strings), dates are strings, and anchors, aliases, merge keys and duplicate keys are refused. The manifest is at most 1 MiB and 1000 entries; one import reads at most 2 GiB of files. Patterns use explicit ASCII classes and end with (?![\s\S]) so ECMA-262 and Python's re read them identically. Width, height, SHA-256 and MIME type are measured from the file, never read from the manifest. Rules this schema cannot express, enforced by the studio: `file` must resolve to a regular file inside the inbox (no symlinks) that Pillow decodes as PNG, JPEG or WebP; a string in `reference_images` must be an asset_id already in the library (or elsewhere in this manifest) and not the entry's own; `commercial_use: yes` without `tos_reviewed` is recorded as `unknown` (warning); `status: approved|rejected` without both `approved_by` and `approved_on` is recorded as `candidate` (warning); `status: approved` is refused unless the recorded commercial_use is `yes` (D5); the same file bytes twice under one asset_id in one manifest is refused. Dates must also be real calendar dates (2026-02-30 is refused even though `format` is only an annotation in draft 2020-12); a file with more than one hard link is refused; a file over 50 MiB, or an image whose header declares more than 100 megapixels, is refused (the pixel count is checked before decoding); re-importing the same bytes under the same asset_id is a no-op and never rewrites the recorded provenance (a differing manifest only warns); two inboxes with the same directory name import into the same batch, import:<name>.

alias.description: An operator alias, never an e-mail address and never containing whitespace.

rfc3339.description: RFC 3339 timestamp with an offset. Seconds 00-59: a leap second (:60) is refused.

httpsUrl.description: https URL: a host, an optional port, then printable ASCII only (percent-encode anything else).

file.description: Path of the image relative to the inbox directory. Absolute paths, '..' components and symlinks are refused. The file is copied into the library; the inbox is never referenced after import.

asset_id.description: The library asset id. Several files may share one asset_id; each becomes its own row. Re-importing the same bytes under the same asset_id is a no-op.

account.description: ALIAS of the provider account used (never the address).

reference_images.description: Images the generation was conditioned on. Bare local paths are refused.

oneOf.description: An asset_id already in this library.

licence_terms_url.description: The provider's terms that govern this image.

tos_reviewed.description: The date those terms were reviewed. Required for commercial_use: yes to be recorded as yes.

commercial_use.description: Whether the terms allow commercial use.

ai_generated.description: Must be true: the library holds AI-generated assets only.

status.description: Approval state. Approval is library metadata for consumers, not a publish gate.

approved_by.description: Alias of who approved (or rejected) the image.
